messages:
eli: heads-up — got a flurry of PagerDuty alerts for inference-kvcache-errors around 10:07 UTC. Customer impact looked limited (timeouts retried), but Slack/PagerDuty noise was bad. Proposing quick signal-prune: short dedupe window + temporary rate-limit + one-off dashboard. Thoughts?

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-042 created (auto). Tags: pdflood, inference. https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-042

sana: +1 to pruning. Suggest: increase PD dedupe to 15m for inference-kvcache-errors, group_by=route_key, and add a suppressor for noisy hosts. Also add a low-priority aggregate alert for spikes so we don't miss regressions.

marta: can do channel-side throttling too — I'll set slack channel posting throttle to 6 msgs / 60s for #eng-oncall to avoid bursts.

jack: be careful — 15m dedupe could hide real regressions if it's a persistent degradation. Recommend adding a 'spike-rate' alert: if unique hosts generating errors > 5 in 5m then trigger a PD with severity=high.

eli: agreed. Sana/Jack, can you prototype the spike alert? Marta can you apply rate-limit/dedupe as temporary mitigation? I'll update the runbook.

sana: prototype snippet (will PR):
```
alert: inference_kvcache_spike
expr: count_over_time(kv_error_count{job="inference"}[5m]) > 5
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: high
```
I'll also add a tag so PD routing goes to oncall-sre.

marta: applying changes now. Creating PR for dedupe rule and slack throttle — https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4821 :thumbsup: ETA 20m.

ops-bot: infra PR CI passed, merged by marta at 10:35 UTC.

jack: I'll add a dashboard panel for unique host counts and a small alert on trend slope. Dropping it into dashboards/ops/inference-noise.

eli: thanks — after PR settles, let's monitor 30m. If noise persists, we'll escalate to model-oncall to roll back latest quantization change. @marta pls handoff to next oncall at 11:00.

marta: handing off to @jack for next hour. I'll be reachable if PDs spike.
